en.title: K
en.summary: The letter K is the twelfth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Sound of letter K
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /k/. Its main sound is heard in (kilogram) /ˈki.lo/, which means kilo. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the back of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Release the air suddenly without using your vocal cords. For the second sound, make that same tap while raising the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Hold a hand to your throat to feel that your voice stays quiet.

sections.title: Reading and spelling
paragraphs: Before back vowels like a, o, u or consonants, this letter makes the sound /k/, that is a plain k sound, as in (karate) /kaˈra.te/. Before front vowels like e or i, it makes the sound /kʲ/, that is a softened k sound, as in (kilo) /ˈki.lo/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of air after this letter. You might say it like the strong start of king. Keep the sound dry, just like the k in skin.
